definitionZh: :目标后 CSS 伪类在滚动标记组中选择在活动滚动标记后出现的滚动标记(目前匹配:目标-当前). 您可以使用此选择器来样式显示当前滚动标记组内导航位置之后的导航项目。
sourceDefinition: The :target-after CSS pseudo-class selects scroll markers that come after the active scroll marker (the one that currently matches :target-current) within a scroll marker group. You can use this selector to style navigation items that come after the current navigation position within a scroll marker group.
